public_rationale: The study released on November 16, 2023 reports that supplied clarifying questions and answers improved responses in structured language-task experiments [e6]. The June 1, 2024 version of CLAMBER reports difficulty identifying ambiguity and generating useful clarification questions [e7]. Neither establishes how February 1–21, 2024 deployments handled the specified historical/contemporary and actual-photo/fictional-character distinctions or sought clarification spontaneously, so the claim remains unresolved [e6, e7].
limitations: Neither item supplies an evaluation matched to the February 2024 deployments and the full set of request distinctions [e6, e7].
Benefits from supplied clarification do not establish that a system reliably decides when to ask for it [e6].
The later benchmark does not establish behavior during the target period or distinguish model capability from product response policy [e7].

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Current AI is not smart enough to behave as a sensible system should, for example by telling historical requests from contemporary ones and requests for real photos from requests for fictional characters, and by asking for clarification when unsure of a request.

our_interpretation: The normative recommendation to clarify is not separately graded; the checkable claim is that current systems lack reliable behavior of the described kind.
The contextual examples require distinguishing request types and seeking clarification when ambiguity affects the answer.
Current AI identifies the systems being discussed; it is not an antecedent for a conditional forecast.
The ongoing-state target is February 2024 through the February 21 post date.
Not smart enough is read as unreliable practical behavior, not a claim that a model can never generate a clarification question.
criteria.support_condition: Evaluations of the relevant deployments document unreliable distinctions among the specified request types and failure to seek useful clarification when needed.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Matched evaluations show reliable handling of these distinctions and appropriate, useful clarification of ambiguous requests.
